data.text:
**Mallory Reed – Platform Engineer**

- **Relevant title & experience:** Currently titled Platform Engineer with ~5 years of experience.
- **Core skills:** Rust, Terraform, AWS — directly aligned with typical platform engineering tooling (IaC, cloud, backend/systems programming).
- **Impact:** Built CI/CD pipelines serving 200 engineers, demonstrating scale and hands-on experience with the kind of developer-facing infrastructure central to the role.

**Verdict:** Strong fit. The skill set and proven CI/CD/build-out experience map well to a platform engineering role. Worth advancing to interview.
